headline: MIL @ CHC matchup research
quickWriteup: The current model score is MIL 4.21 at CHC 3.75, with a projected total of 7.96. Movement read: The side movement strengthened toward MIL: MIL moved +0.22 runs while CHC moved -0.38, changing the projected margin by +0.60 runs. NRFI probability dropped -15.4%, so the first-inning read became more YRFI/early-scoring friendly. Pitching context: Shota Imanaga has the better recent run-prevention profile in the available outing logs at 1.8 ER over the last 5 outings. Batter research is strongest for Alex Bregman, Jackson Chourio, Sal Frelick, based on recent hit rates, matching location/opponent samples, or similar-game production. The cold/risk list flags Matt Shaw, Ian Happ because the recent hit profile or strikeout trend is weaker than the projection alone would show.
